# HiddenData Vault

> HiddenData is a cross-platform, zero-disk, zero-knowledge encrypted media vault studio for PC (Chrome Extension) and Android (Native App), featuring in-memory AES-256-GCM streaming playback and client-side encrypted Google Drive cloud sync.

## Overview

HiddenData solves the vulnerability of sensitive photos, GIFs, and videos leaking through temporary cache files on disk, browser history, or cloud provider inspection. It operates under a strict Zero-Knowledge architecture: files are encrypted client-side before touching disk or cloud, and decrypted on-the-fly strictly within volatile memory (RAM) with 0 bytes written to disk caches.

- **Primary Platforms**: PC / Mac / Linux (Google Chrome Extension via Side Panel and Fullscreen Studio) and Android (Native Kotlin / Jetpack Compose App).
- **Core Use Cases**: Secure personal photo/video vault, zero-trace encrypted media viewing, client-side encrypted Google Drive backup, multi-device cross-platform synchronization without third-party relay servers.

## Cryptographic & Technical Specifications

- **Symmetric Encryption**: AES-256-GCM (Galois/Counter Mode) authenticated encryption with associated data (AEAD) ensuring confidentiality and cryptographic integrity verification.
- **Key Derivation Function (KDF)**: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with 100,000 iterations and a 16-byte cryptographically secure random salt (`crypto.getRandomValues`).
- **Key Slot Manager & Envelope Architecture**: Payload data is encrypted with an ephemeral Data Encryption Key (DEK). The DEK is sealed inside key slots wrapped by a Key Encryption Key (KEK) derived from the user's master credentials. Allows password updates and multi-device access without re-encrypting large media files.
- **V3 Envelope Header**: 49-byte compact binary header with instant 0.005s embedded encrypted thumbnail previews for lightning-fast gallery browsing.
- **Zero-Disk In-Memory Streaming**: 64KB chunked streaming engine decrypts video and image segments directly into RAM memory buffers. No decrypted blocks are ever flushed to disk, swap temp files, or OS temp directories.
- **Google Drive Integration**: Minimal `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file` OAuth scope. HiddenData only accesses files created or opened by HiddenData itself (`.enc` and encrypted configuration files). It cannot read or modify any other files in the user's Google Drive.
- **Cross-Platform Sync**: HMAC-SHA256 verified license and settings synchronization between Chrome Extension and Android Native App via user's private Google Drive storage. No proprietary synchronization servers or middleman telemetry.

## Pricing & Licensing

- **Free Plan**: 100% Lifetime Free for single local vault (unlimited file encryption/decryption, zero-disk in-memory streaming).
- **Pro Plan**: Unlimited vaults (USB/SSD/work), subfolders, and encrypted Google Drive cloud sync ($8.99 lifetime).
- **Pro Lifetime License**: $8.99 USD one-time purchase. Zero subscriptions, no recurring fees. Unlocks unlimited multi-vaults, subfolders, and encrypted Google Drive cloud sync, with simultaneous lifetime Pro activation across both PC Chrome Extension and Android Mobile App.
- **Merchant of Record**: Polar (14-day money-back guarantee, secure international checkout via polar.sh).
